login.title: Sign in — Trading bot
login.heading: Sign in
language.name: English
auth.lockout: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
positions.title: Open positions
positions.help: Profit is net: the sale commission and the tax on the gain are taken off the proceeds, then compared with the cost of the buy (price plus commissions and taxes already recorded). Current threshold: {threshold}.
buy.title: Record a buy
buy.help: This is the opening record of the lot. Leave price and commissions empty and the bot uses the latest price in the archive and the commission from preferences. Taxes on the buy stay zero unless you set them: tax on the gain is calculated on the sale.
buy.bad_numbers: Quantity, price, or costs are not readable.
buy.bad_amount: Quantity must be greater than zero.
buy.over_max: The amount is above the maximum investment. Raise the preference or reduce the quantity.
buy.negative: Commissions and taxes cannot be negative.
tx.title: Latest transactions
volume.heading: Volume and state
volume.caption: Among {where}, the {count} names with the highest return over the last {sessions} sessions. In the chart: {shown}. Size is volume.
volume.bad_count: Names must be from 10 to 500, in steps of 10.
chart.line_no_ohlc: {asset} — daily closes (open, high and low are missing)
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.foot: The initial commission is 0.1% and the tax is 26% of the gain. With 100 names the update is shorter; 500 can take several minutes.
prefs.names_title: How many names to show (10 to 500, in steps of 10)
prefs.days_title: Days of history in the chart
prefs.age_title: Maximum price age for a sale (hours)
prefs.scale_title: Size and line height (%). The percentage applies to both.
prefs.theme_title: Light and Dark stay fixed. Automatic follows local time: light from 7 to 19, dark from 19 to 7.
prefs.err.numbers: One of the numbers is not readable.
prefs.err.scale_read: The type size is not readable.
prefs.err.profit: The profit threshold must be between 0 and 5.
prefs.err.invest: The maximum investment must be greater than zero.
prefs.err.fee: The commission must be between 0 and 0.1.
prefs.err.tax: The tax must be between 0 and 0.5.
prefs.err.band: The flat band must be between 0 and 0.2.
prefs.err.names: Names in the volume chart run from 10 to 500, in steps of 10.
prefs.err.chart: The history chart can be a line or candles.
prefs.err.draw: The history drawing can be an image or a vector.
prefs.err.scale: Size and line height run from 80 to 120, in steps of 5.
prefs.err.theme: The theme can be light, dark, or automatic.
prefs.err.symbol: The chart symbol is not valid.
prefs.err.limits: History days, sessions, or price age are out of range.
prefs.err.notice: The message seconds must be between 3 and 30.
prices.current: Prices are already up to date.
prices.queue: Massive: {pending} closed sessions still to fill. This run requests {chosen}. The open session is not included.
prices.plan: Session {day} is outside the plan history. It will not be requested again.
prices.empty: Session {day} has no bars. It will not be requested again.
prices.partial: Session {day} returned only {count} names from the list. Stopping before marking it complete.
prices.auth: Massive rejected the key. Bars already written stay.
prices.rate: Massive asked to slow down. Bars already written stay.
prices.incomplete: Massive did not finish the download. Bars already written stay.
prices.done: Update finished. Bars written: {stored}. Sales recorded: {sold}.
prices.dead: The last update is no longer running. Start it again.
reread.running: Reading sessions already in the archive.
reread.ready: The extra fields are already on every archived session.
reread.queue: Reading {count} sessions already in the archive. The response has no fields beyond the ones now stored.
error.internal: Internal error. The detail is in the bot log.
